<Heading

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/receipts"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists receipts in ascending receipt-id order, a page at a time,
optionally narrowed to one ASN and/or one state.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>
